summary: RFC 6567 describes the motivation and use cases for carrying ISDN user-to-user information across SIP. As networks move to SIP, this document defines how to interwork the ISDN DSS1 user-user information element with SIP so the data survives the translation.

eli5.summary: Old phone lines and new internet phone systems speak different languages. This document explains how to pass a small attached message from one to the other without it getting lost.
